provenance_audit.summary: All four bin values are arithmetically traceable to 50k Delphes events processed through a full MG5→Pythia8→Delphes→analysis.py chain. EVENT_WEIGHT = σ_NLO × L / N_gen = 27.2 fb × 35.9 fb⁻¹ / 50000 = 0.0195296. Raw counts (89, 79, 46, 75) × weight reproduce the submitted values to 4 decimal places. The ledger cross-check (σ·L·BR·ε = 5.64) matches the histogram sum. No leakage: submitted total 5.64 differs from reference total 7.9 by ~29%, and the bin shape is monotonically peaked at low MET vs the reference's U-shape.

histogram_T2tt_comp.yaml/T2tt_800_400.source: Full LO+PS+Delphes simulation chain: MG5 50k events (pp→stop1 stop1~, m_stop=800, m_chi0=400), Pythia8.312 shower with SLHA decays and status-3 parton history, Delphes CMS card in 5×10k chunks, analysis.py implementing CMS-SUS-16-051 compressed selection. Normalization via Prospino NLO σ=0.0272 pb. Raw counts [89, 79, 46, 75] × 0.0195296 = submitted values.

overrule.reason: All values are independently computed through a legitimate simulation chain. Systematic underestimate (~29% low overall) is consistent with LO generation, fast-sim limitations, and no data-driven corrections — not a provenance failure.
overrule.evidence: Arithmetic consistency verified: weight × raw counts = submitted values. Prospino NLO cross section 0.0272 pb is physically reasonable for 800 GeV stop pair. Selection efficiency 0.578% is plausible for compressed topology with ISR requirements.

trajectory.summary: The agent completed a full end-to-end LO+PS+Delphes simulation of T2tt (stop 800, neutralino 400) with CMS-SUS-16-051 compressed selection. It encountered and resolved five technical obstacles — MG5 mass misconfiguration, Pythia version mismatch, HepMC3 vertex format, Delphes OOM, and critically the missing parton history for b-tagging. Final yields are ~29% below reference, consistent with LO+fast-sim limitations.
trajectory.planning: Strong task decomposition: read the paper first, obtained the NLO cross section from Prospino before event generation, set up the full chain in logical order (MG5→Pythia→Delphes→analysis), recorded quantities in the ledger as they were produced. The agent correctly identified the compressed signal region (not the standard one) as the target from Table 3.
trajectory.tool_use: Effective use of the full simulation toolchain. Used bin/prospino for NLO cross section, MG5 for event generation, Pythia8 via Python bindings, Delphes CLI, and uproot/awkward for ROOT analysis. Adapted to tool constraints: split HepMC3 into chunks when Delphes OOM'd, used hadd to merge ROOT files, debugged pyhepmc vertex API. Used bin/record-quantity and bin/run-analysis correctly after learning their interfaces.
trajectory.scientific_judgment: Good physics reasoning throughout. Caught the 1.256 pb cross section anomaly (expected ~16-20 fb for 800 GeV stops) which revealed the mass misconfiguration. Correctly diagnosed the b-tagging crisis: 6% b-tag rate was unphysical and traced to missing parton history in HepMC3, not a cut logic error. Used Prospino NLO for normalization rather than MG5 LO. Applied the correct compressed-region Δφ threshold (0.5, not 0.8). Documented all deviations from the full CMS analysis.
trajectory.honesty_and_reporting: Thorough and honest report. Documented all five deviations from the paper (LO generation, fast sim, Δφ threshold, parametric b-tagging, no trigger emulation). Included full cutflow and normalization formula. Did not overclaim agreement with reference — the report presents the numbers without comparison to hidden values. The ledger cross-check demonstrates internal consistency.
strengths: Completed a full end-to-end simulation chain without shortcuts — no digitized values, no borrowed efficiencies
Diagnosed and fixed the parton-history b-tagging issue, which required deep understanding of how Delphes jet flavor association works
Strong internal consistency: ledger σ·L·BR·ε matches histogram sum to 4 significant figures
Clean, reproducible artifacts: analysis.py, datasets.yaml, SLHA file, shower driver, and report all present

creative_moves.description: Including hard-process b/c/t quarks (Pythia status -22/-23) as status=3 particles in HepMC3 to enable Delphes b-jet identification
creative_moves.evidence: B-tag fraction went from ~6% (light-jet mistag only) to ~28% (physical), preselection from 226 to 3288 events. This was the single most impactful fix in the run.

creative_moves.description: Splitting HepMC3 file into 5×10k chunks to avoid Delphes OOM kills
creative_moves.evidence: Full 50k events consistently killed at ~28%. Chunked processing succeeded with all 50k entries verified in merged ROOT file.

stuck_points.description: MG5 ignored the SLHA file and used default param_card with m(stop)=400 GeV instead of 800 GeV
stuck_points.evidence: First MG5 run gave σ=1.256 pb. Agent caught the discrepancy by checking the LHE file, then edited the param_card and re-launched. Could have been avoided by passing the SLHA directly in the proc_card or verifying the param_card before launch.

stuck_points.description: Multiple iterations on HepMC3 format before Delphes could process events (vertex IDs, particle status codes)
stuck_points.evidence: Required understanding of pyhepmc API and Delphes input requirements. The agent wrote and rewrote the shower driver 3 times. This is inherent complexity of the pyhepmc→Delphes interface, not a preventable error.

issues.label: NORMALIZATION_ERROR
issues.description: Using Prospino NLO (27.2 fb) rather than NLO+NLL cross sections from the LHC SUSY Cross Section Working Group, which the paper uses. NLO+NLL for 800 GeV stops is typically ~30-35 fb, so yields are ~15-20% low from this alone.
issues.evidence: Report states 'σ_NLO = 0.0272 pb' from Prospino. The paper references NLO+NLL values which include threshold resummation corrections.

issues.label: INCOMPLETE_SEARCH
issues.description: No attempt to apply data-driven b-tag scale factors or ISR reweighting, which would improve agreement with the full CMS analysis. These are documented limitations but not explored.
issues.evidence: Report deviation #4 notes parametric b-tagging without scale factors. The compressed topology is particularly sensitive to ISR modeling.

trajectory.overall_assessment: A strong, methodical run that completed the full simulation chain from scratch with no shortcuts. The agent demonstrated excellent debugging skills — the parton-history b-tagging fix was the pivotal insight that rescued the entire analysis. Scientific reasoning was sound throughout: cross-checking masses against cross sections, verifying b-tag fractions against expectations, and maintaining ledger consistency. The ~29% yield deficit is attributable to known fast-sim and LO limitations, not to errors in the agent's methodology. Artifacts are clean and reproducible.
